import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.JacobianDataCharts

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite

namespace ProbeR2c

open AlgebraicGeometry

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

-- Probe: the lft certificate is a property of pic0TypeFunctor, not of the carrier.
example {J J' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
    (rep' : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J')
    (h : LocallyOfFiniteType J'.hom) : LocallyOfFiniteType J.hom := by
  have e := rep.uniqueUpToIso rep'
  have hiso : IsIso e.hom.left :=
    ⟨e.inv.left, by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.hom_inv_id]; rfl,
      by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.inv_hom_id]; rfl⟩
  have hw : e.hom.left ≫ J'.hom = J.hom := Over.w e.hom
  rw [← hw]
  haveI := h
  infer_instance

-- Probe: same for QuasiCompact.
example {J J' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J)
    (rep' : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J')
    (h : QuasiCompact J'.hom) : QuasiCompact J.hom := by
  have e := rep.uniqueUpToIso rep'
  have hiso : IsIso e.hom.left :=
    ⟨e.inv.left, by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.hom_inv_id]; rfl,
      by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.inv_hom_id]; rfl⟩
  have hw : e.hom.left ≫ J'.hom = J.hom := Over.w e.hom
  rw [← hw]
  haveI := h
  infer_instance

-- Probe: hence a JacobianData transports off ANY representing carrier.
noncomputable example {J : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    (rep : (pic0TypeFunctor C).RepresentableBy J) (d : JacobianData C) :
    JacobianData C :=
  JacobianData.ofRepresentableBy C J rep
    (by
      have e := rep.uniqueUpToIso d.rep
      have hiso : IsIso e.hom.left :=
        ⟨e.inv.left, by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.hom_inv_id]; rfl,
          by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.inv_hom_id]; rfl⟩
      have hw : e.hom.left ≫ d.J.hom = J.hom := Over.w e.hom
      rw [← hw]
      haveI := d.locallyOfFiniteType
      infer_instance)
    (by
      have e := rep.uniqueUpToIso d.rep
      have hiso : IsIso e.hom.left :=
        ⟨e.inv.left, by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.hom_inv_id]; rfl,
          by rw [← Over.comp_left, e.inv_hom_id]; rfl⟩
      have hw : e.hom.left ≫ d.J.hom = J.hom := Over.w e.hom
      rw [← hw]
      haveI := d.quasiCompact
      infer_instance)

theorem controlSorry : True := by sorry

end ProbeR2c
